app_info.subtitle: Professional track & field coaching
app_info.description: Ralchev Coach helps sprinters, hurdlers, jumpers and combined-events athletes get an initial assessment and connect with professional track & field coach Ivan Ralchev for individualized online coaching.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns static public information about coach Ivan Ralchev and does not modify any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to external systems or public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, modify or destroy data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns static service and pricing information only.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not perform external actions or write to third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or delete data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Processes user-supplied training context in memory and returns structured assessment context without storing or changing external data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send data to external services or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or alter user data or third-party data.
